name: alphabet-index
title: Alphabet index
description: An A to Z rail to jump through a long list: drag a finger down it, see the letter in a bubble, skip the empty letters.
docs: Put it beside a scrolling list and give it a height (h-full inside a flex row). Pass letters as a string or an array (years and numbers work), available for the letters that have entries, value for the one your list is showing, and scroll the list to that section in onSelect. Press or drag along the rail with a finger, a pen or a mouse: onSelect is called once per letter crossed, the bubble shows it, and letters without entries give way to the nearest one that has some. For the keyboard it is a list of buttons: Tab enters it at the current letter, the arrow keys, Home and End move, Enter selects, and Tab or Shift+Tab leaves it from wherever focus is. Set bubble to false to leave the bubble out.
